decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting lies far from the firm's established building and industrial lighting knowledge, so despite in-house R&D the firm can hardly interpret results or improve the product, and only a mention rather than its own page suggests weak commitment.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build directly on the firm's engineering and certified manufacturing know-how, and the follow-up LED replacement kit shows active learning and development.
The relaunched designer task light is close to the firm's established offer and had its own page in both years, so the firm can assimilate feedback and keep refining it with LED technology.
The pendant office luminaire sits squarely within the firm's core professional lighting knowledge, which supports learning from early results within its LED roadmap.
The premium pendant luminaire builds on established competencies and in-house R&D, making it easy to interpret and improve, so the firm retains it.
